admission.justification: A modeled directory or stale provider manifest can silently validate the wrong ACP provider classification.

applicability: The checked-in ACP discovery fixture and its renew and check command.
conditions: The source server, protocol, plugin and CLI package versions match the host contract.
The manifest records copied paths, byte counts and SHA-256 digests.
exclusions: This fixture is a selected source distribution copy. It does not witness behavior of an installed host.

evidence: Worker L10-W5-FIXTURE and Reviewer L10-F03. Exact 19-file installed-source comparison in W5-pinned-host-and-fixture-memory-review.md.
handoff.path: L10 curated W6 rules and history

statement: The ACP fixture copies recorded files from an installed distribution at the host pin. Renewal preserves an existing README. The --check command requires that README and verifies the recorded file list and copied bytes.
